Songdo Convensia

송도 컨벤시아

5th ARPES workshop will take place at Songdo Convensia in Songdo, Incheon, South Korea, on November 18–20, 2026. The workshop is hosted by Yonsei University.

Address
123 Central-ro, Yeonsu-gu, Incheon 21998, South Korea
인천광역시 연수구 센트럴로 123
By subway
Incheon National University Station, Incheon Subway Line 1.
Take Exit 4 and walk approximately 10 minutes to the venue.
